The Opportunity
The AI infrastructure market is exploding. Every hyperscaler, every cloud provider, every AI company is building custom silicon. But they all face the same problem: how do you connect hundreds of chips, deliver clean power at scale, and move terabits of data without melting the package?
That's what we solve. TylSemi builds the chiplet infrastructure IP - the IO, power delivery, and interconnect building blocks - that makes AI/HPC systems actually work at scale.
This isn't a nice-to-have. It's the critical path.
Why Now
The Market Window
The semiconductor industry is going through its biggest architectural shift in 40 years:

•
Moore's Law is dead. 2nm and beyond delivers marginal performance gains. The future is chiplets, not monolithic dies.

•
Custom silicon is now mainstream. Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, OpenAI - they're all designing their own ASICs. The $50B custom silicon market is growing 30% annually.

•
IO and power are the bottleneck. Solve hard problems and provide something which is a category in itself.

Translation: We're entering the market at exactly the moment when every major AI/HPC player needs what we're building, and their alternatives are disappearing.
Culture & Team: How We Work
No Politics, No Bureaucracy
There are no layers, no approval chains, no corporate theater.

• If you have an idea, we test it. If it works, we ship it.

• No endless meetings, no PowerPoint presentations to convince middle management.

Remote-Friendly, Global Team

•
US team: Bay Area preferred, but we hire the best people regardless of location

•
India team: Building a world-class design center in Bangalore

Move Fast, Ship Real Products
We're not a research project. We have paying customers, committed capital, and aggressive timelines.
This is a company, not a lifestyle business. We're building to win.
What We Value

•
Ownership mindset. You're not here to execute someone else's roadmap. You're here to define it.

•
Bias for action. We move fast. Analysis paralysis doesn't fly here.

•
Deep technical expertise. This is hard engineering. We need people who've shipped real silicon and debugged real hardware.

•
Low ego, high standards. We don't care about titles or politics. We care about results.

The Ask
If you're reading this, you're probably comfortable. You have a good job at a stable company with all the benefits.
We're asking you to walk away from that and bet on us.
Here's why you should:

•
The market is real. AI infrastructure spending is $200B+ annually and growing 40% YoY. Every hyperscaler needs what we're building.

•
The team has done this before. We've built and exited semiconductor companies at scale. This isn't our first rodeo.

•
The traction is de-risked. We have LOIs, strategic investors, and a clear path to revenue.

•
The work is consequential. You're not optimizing someone's ad click-through rate. You're building the silicon infrastructure that powers AI.

This is the bet. Join us and build something that matters.
Or stay comfortable. No judgment.
But if you're the kind of person who wants to take the shot, we'd love to talk.

• Du arbeitest lieber remote oder im Office? Wir können beides, ganz wie du willst.

• Besonders schön: Bei ida hast du die Möglichkeit, die Angebote der öffentlich-rechtlichen Rundfunkanstalten und anderer Medienhäuser maßgeblich mitzugestalten und zu verbessern - und damit einen positiven Beitrag für unsere Gesellschaft zu leisten.

das bringst du mit

• Unerlässlich: Du hast fundierte Führungserfahrung im agilen Kontext und Erfahrung im Führung von Führungskräften. Das heißt, du verstehst dich in erster Linie als Manager:in und Enabler:in und nicht als operativ mitarbeitende:r Entwickler:in.

was uns besonders wichtig ist

Diversität ist etwas, wonach wir streben. FLINTA* , BIPoC, LGBTQIA+ und Menschen mit Behinderung möchten wir daher ganz ausdrücklich ermutigen, sich bei ida zu bewerben. Wir haben hier einige Anforderungen aufgeschrieben, aber du erfüllst nicht alle? Macht nix. Wir freuen uns auf dich.

At Motorola Solutions , we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. The Global Education Department enables Motorola Solutions ’ technologies to be deployed, used, and supported with confidence. We create scalable training and learning experiences for customers, partners, and employees worldwide. Through clear, effective education on our products and solutions, we directly support safer communities and more resilient organizations.

Job Description
The Senior Instructional Designer is an end-to-end learning architect and author within the Online Training Team. This role is responsible for the full lifecycle-from front-end performance analysis and learner persona creation to hands-on development and portfolio maintenance-of high-quality online technical product training.
This is a full-stack, hands-on instructional design and development role . The ideal candidate does not just write storyboards or manage vendors; they directly author interactive eLearning, translate complex software UI changes into task-based user workflows, and own learning products from strategy to finished build. Success requires deep instructional design theory, advanced proficiency in authoring tools like Articulate Storyline 360, and comfort leveraging emerging technologies-including generative AI-to accelerate output.

• Multimedia Production: Produce supporting multimedia assets-including software demo videos, animations, and graphics-using tools like Camtasia and the Adobe Creative Suite.

• Portfolio & Asset Lifecycle Management: Manage, prioritize, and maintain the ongoing accuracy of training assets across a product portfolio to align with rapid release cycles and product roadmaps.

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. The Account Manager will be instrumental in helping grow and retain Clipboard's existing markets. Healthcare providers are core to the Clipboard marketplace - the Account Manager is in charge of nurturing and expanding relationships with current users, going deep with those users to understand their needs, and ensuring they're consistently successful on the platform. There's no ceiling to what you can achieve in this role - if you're highly motivated to go above and beyond, a diligent executor, and a strong written/verbal communicator, Clipboard is the place for you to excel.

Responsibilities

- Managing and growing relationships with an existing portfolio of healthcare providers and dental offices

- Clearly articulating the value proposition of the app to current users to drive continued engagement and expansion

- Going deep with healthcare providers and dental offices to uncover their evolving needs, understand their challenges, and find ways to genuinely help them succeed on the platform

- Establishing credibility and rapport with providers, which includes demonstrating a strong understanding of the app

- Being the go-to point of contact for users that need help navigating the app, resolving issues, and getting the most out of the platform

- Helping fill new and urgent shifts in your assigned markets

Qualifications

- Willingness to hustle / lack of fear

- Experience texting, emailing, and talking with English-speaking clients and prospects

Requirements

- Stable high-speed internet connection

- A computer workstation (laptop or desktop)

- Internationally located (not in US, CA, UK, NZ, or AU)

- Availability to work US working hours

- Fluency in English speaking and writing

Beyond the Basics - What Will Make You Successful

- Noticing & Curiosity - You pick up on things others miss and ask "why" more than once because the first answer is rarely the whole story. You dig to understand the root of a problem or situation rather than accepting things at face value, and you're constantly updating your understanding of the customers you serve.

- Initiative & Persistence - You have a bias for action. You know that our customers are dealing with real problems today, and you don't wait for perfect information before making a move. You're scrappy and self-reliant, you find ways through obstacles rather than around them, and you bring solutions instead of asking "what should I do?"

- Ownership - The buck stops with you, no matter what anyone else did or did not do. You take full responsibility for your results, fix problems when you see them - even outside your immediate area - and put processes in place to make sure those problems don't happen again.
